description: Generate an animation or GUI scaling .mcmeta document from a PNG. Writes only to the explicit .mcmeta outputPath (never merges; force replaces the whole file); without outputPath it returns the text. The PNG is read only. Checks the document is valid, not how it looks in game.

border.description: gui nine_slice: border N or per-side object (required there).

force.description: Replace an existing outputPath file as a whole.

frameSize.description: animation: frame size N or WxH (required).

frames.description: animation: playback order of indices and/or {index,time}; repeats and partial lists are valid. Omitted means all frames in order.

holdTicks.description: animation preset: ticks the first frame rests for, default 100.

inputPath.description: PNG path; read only, never written.

minecraftVersion.description: Release Minecraft version 1.19.3 through 26.3 (for example "1.19.3", "1.21.4", "26.3"). Omitted means engine defaults.

mode.description: animation writes an animation section; gui a gui.scaling one.

outputPath.description: Explicit .mcmeta path. When omitted nothing is written and the document text is returned.

preset.description: animation: expand frames from a named timeline shape; conflicts with frames.

resourcePackVersion.description: Target resource-pack version as N or N.M (e.g. 84, 97.1); normalized to major.minor. Omitted means engine defaults.

stretchInner.description: gui nine_slice only: stretch the inner bands.

name: mcmeta_asset
